document: Icarus Yield Bot Product Requirement Document (PRD)

feature_list.wallet_control: Can buy and sell on ETH and EVM-compatible networks.
feature_list.data_pipeline: Has access to real-time and historical blockchain data
feature_list.strategy_management: Has knowledge of various management strategies and can choose to use
feature_list.yield_farming: optimize risk optimized yield on DeFi lending protocols - aave mostly
feature_list.reporting: generate monthly an quarterly performance reports with P/L sent to discord
feature_list.logging: keeps a log of all transactions executed by the bot
feature_list.tax_prep: can prepare transactions for tax reporting

prd.overview: AAn autonomous, multi-strategy DeFi asset management bot that holds crypto and stable coins with the goal to increase the portfolio value in CAD @20-50% APY while paying 5% of the profit/gains to the user on a quarterly basis.
prd.target_user: One specific person - the builder of the tool
prd.user_goal: Deposit Eth/USDC into the bot's wallet and receives quarterly payments based on the bot's performance.
success_criteria: The bot can access realtime blockchain data
The bot has access to a smart wallet and can execute transactions
The bot can decide what to hold as the base yield currency
The bot can execute a trade strategy
The bot can send quarterly payments
The bot is packaged as a docker container
